title: Rafael and the Inheritance
author: Astrid Sandoval
blurb: Oscar Okafor, a night-shift dispatcher for a taxi company, prides themselves on never taking a case they can't close. But when a body turns up dressed in clothes stolen from the witness's own closet, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must find the witness everyone swears is dead before the tide gives up what it took.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
